author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 19: Two-Stage Optimization for Eligibility
abstract:
Single-stage multi-objective optimization has failed to produce a new structure. This experiment attempts a two-stage approach.
Stage 1: A multi-objective SLSQP with a very high penalty weight is run to find a packing that satisfies the Appendix E 'rigidity' criteria, ignoring the score.
Stage 2: This new 'rigid' packing is then used as a seed for the standard 'Exhaustive Jitter Search' to maximize the score.
The hypothesis is that separating the goals of achieving rigidity and maximizing score will be more effective.
